goals: Harden Godot 4 into a real game-engine layer instead of a scene-specific demo.
Keep owned, permissive, private-reference, and unknown assets in distinct rights lanes.
Make Android use the Mobile renderer while retaining Compatibility as automatic fallback.
Provide a Forward+ ultra profile for workstation captures without making it the phone baseline.
Add PBR material ingest, facial blend-shape inspection, secondary-motion hooks, private mod registry, render profiles, and deterministic audits.

samsung_mobile_beta.shadowPolicy: one primary directional shadow caster; hero local lights default shadowless

compatibility_fallback.purpose: automatic low-end/fallback lane, not visual target

assetPolicy.thirdPartyPrivateRule: May be used only in private mod/source-reference workflows unless redistribution rights are explicitly proven.
assetPolicy.sourcePreservation: Never overwrite original Drive/Library/source assets; forge derivatives into versioned beta staging paths.

secondaryMotion: optional adult bust bones when explicitly present in rig
characterContract.secondaryMotionEngine: SpringBoneSimulator3D when unscaled compatible bone chains exist
characterContract.hardBlock: Do not enable spring-bone simulation on a scaled Skeleton3D hierarchy; bake/apply character scale first.

modContract.nexusStyleAssets: private ingest only until license/redistribution and file audit pass
modContract.packaging: mods are never silently promoted into the public APK
